CLM_001_LABS_PUBLISH_SAFETY_FRAMEWORKS.editorial_rationale: The first post-hook evidence now shows the two strongest real framework covers side by side: Anthropic's Responsible Scaling Policy and Google DeepMind's Frontier Safety Framework. This satisfies the claim's two-publisher evidence requirement without forcing viewers through a three-page opening carousel; the film moves from human-scale footage to two legible primary sources, then back into cinematic context.

CLM_004_AGENTIC_MISALIGNMENT_TEST.editorial_rationale: The claim describes a published controlled evaluation; showing the paper's own real Figure 1 (simulated blackmail rates across five models) is direct primary-source evidence of what was actually measured, in place of a source-derived recreation card.
